component.name: Arara Music
component.summary: Fast music player with synced karaoke lyrics
Player de música rápido com letras sincronizadas em modo karaokê

description.p: Arara Music opens instantly and stays light even with large libraries. It keeps an index of your music, caches album art on disk and fetches synced lyrics from LRCLIB.
O Arara Music abre na hora e continua leve mesmo com bibliotecas grandes. Ele mantém um índice das suas músicas, guarda as capas em cache no disco e busca letras sincronizadas no LRCLIB.

ul.li: Albums, artists, favourites, recently played and playlists
Word-by-word karaoke lyrics (LRC, enhanced LRC, embedded tags, LRCLIB)
Media keys and GNOME media controls (MPRIS)
Follows the system dark style and accent color
